author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Rejected drawing squeezed J and S into a 24x16 space inside a landscape frame, so both letters crushed into stubby blobs; redrawn as full-height geometric J (stem into an r6 hook) and S (two elliptical bowls with a smooth spine), matching the reference's thin letterforms, like the set's typescript-logo. Checked 48px light/dark.
omissions: Rounded square frame omitted: with 8-unit clearance it leaves at most 20-24 units inside, which cannot hold a readable J and S side by side.
